about:
Writes tests/vectors/bootcreds-v1.json: regalia.site documents and the boot credentials
deploy/baremetal/bootcreds.render gives for them under many manifests, byte for byte, so the initrd's Go
renderer (cmd/regalia-unlock/bootcfg) is held to the very same output: which peers, in which order, their
WireGuard keys, the ruleset, boot.env, and every refusal.

documents.name: not canonical (spaces)
documents.refused: regalia.site is not in canonical form

documents.name: not canonical (a newline)
documents.refused: regalia.site is not in canonical form

documents.name: another schema
documents.refused: regalia.site: schema must be regalia.boot-site/v1

documents.name: an extra field
documents.refused: regalia.site fields mismatch: missing=[] unknown=['extra']

documents.name: no device
documents.refused: regalia.site fields mismatch: missing=['device'] unknown=[]

documents.name: a device with a space
documents.refused: regalia.site: device must be a plain path

documents.name: host_ipv4 a network
documents.refused: regalia.site: host_ipv4 must be an IPv4 address

documents.name: host_ipv4 loopback
documents.refused: regalia.site: host_ipv4 must be a host address

documents.name: boot_mesh null
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh must not be null

documents.name: an upper-case MAC
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.nic_mac must be a unicast MAC address, lower case and colon-separated

documents.name: a multicast MAC
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.nic_mac must be a unicast MAC address, lower case and colon-separated

documents.name: prefix 0
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.prefix must be a prefix length from 1 to 32

documents.name: prefix true
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.prefix must be a prefix length from 1 to 32

documents.name: a gateway off the link
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.gateway must be another address inside 192.0.2.0/24 (host_ipv4 and its prefix), or null

documents.name: the host as gateway
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.gateway must be another address inside 192.0.2.0/24 (host_ipv4 and its prefix), or null

documents.name: the broadcast as gateway
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.gateway must be a host of 192.0.2.0/24, not its network or broadcast address

documents.name: no peers
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.peers must list 1 to 8 nodes

documents.name: nine peers
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.peers must list 1 to 8 nodes

documents.name: a peer that is the node
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.peers[0].node_id must be another node's ID, listed once

documents.name: two peers at one address
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.peers[1]: no two nodes share an address, inside or outside the tunnel, and no address is both

documents.name: a peer at the host's address
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.peers[0]: no two nodes share an address, inside or outside the tunnel, and no address is both

documents.name: the tunnel address is the host's
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.address is the tunnel's address, not host_ipv4

documents.name: the initrd's interface
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.interface must be a WireGuard interface of its own, named wg-… (at most 15 characters, and not wg-boot, the initrd's)

documents.name: port 0
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.listen_port must be a port number 1-65535

documents.name: a node ID in upper case
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.node_id is not a node ID

documents.name: a peer with an extra field
documents.refused: regalia.site: boot_mesh.peers[0] needs exactly ['node_id', 'underlay', 'address']

documents.name: a float port
documents.refused: floats are not allowed (51820.0)

documents.name: a duplicate field
documents.refused: duplicate field 'device'
